name: Courtney Parella
current_role: Head of public affairs, U.S. Department of Labor (deputy assistant secretary from March 2025)
summary: Courtney Parella runs press for the Labor Department and is the media contact on its 2026 announcements. The department named her deputy assistant secretary in the Office of Public Affairs in March 2025; later federal appointee listings give her as assistant secretary.
